page.overview:
Who is QR?

QR is a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. She is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit.

QR is a Tele-Viper. She is a member of Scar Squad and the only card-carrying member of Cobra in the team. Her loyalty was bought by Faceless, but she is willing to turn on the rest of the team in order to keep herself safe.

She has two roles in Faceless' plan. The first is to use one of Destro's EMP satellites to knock The Pit's systems offline. The second is to hack into its computers in order to steal vital information.

G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game (Renegade Game Studios) pg 318. "Snake Pit Introductory Adventure."
